title: Senior Consultant | Frontend Developer - Java | Kolkata | Operations, Industry & Domain Solutions
Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front\-End Engineer

Experience: 5 to 7 years  
Employment Type: Full\-time

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are mandatory for this role.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Front\-End Engineer to build scalable, high\-performance, and intuitive enterprise applications powered by AI and agentic AI. This role requires strong front\-end engineering expertise and the ability to translate complex AI workflows into seamless user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop scalable, responsive, and production\-grade web applications.
* Build reusable UI components using React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* Design intuitive interfaces for AI agents, conversational applications, dashboards, and enterprise workflows.
* Integrate front\-end applications with REST APIs, GraphQL, and AI services.
* Build real\-time interfaces for streaming AI responses, notifications, and workflow status.
* Optimize application performance, security, accessibility, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Implement testing, code reviews, CI/CD practices, and front\-end engineering standards.
* Collaborate closely with AI engineers, back\-end teams, product managers, and UI/UX designers.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to front\-end architecture decisions.

Required Skills and Experience

* 5 to 7 years of professional front\-end engineering experience.
* Strong expertise in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Strong understanding of component architecture, state management, and responsive design.
* Experience integrating APIs, AI services, and real\-time data.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
* Good understanding of performance optimization, accessibility, and application security.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building enterprise SaaS, generative AI, LLM, or agentic AI applications involving complex dashboards, conversational interfaces, and workflow\-driven user experiences.

To apply, email your resume to hr@bayshoreintel.com.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Frontend Developer (React Native/Electron)- Kolkata candidates only
description:
**EXPERIENCE\-** 2\-6 YEARS.

**Job Location\-** Kolkata, work from office only (Near City Centre 2 Mall, Rajarhat).

We are looking for a **React Native Developer** with hands\-on experience in **React Native/Electron**, with strong expertise in **React Native/Electron and Vite**. The candidate should have a good understanding of **JavaScript, Redux, React Router, frontend CI/CD**.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Well\-grounded knowledge of React extensions like React Router.
* Knowledge of frontend CI/CD pipelines.
* Demonstrated experience with building full\-stack applications.
* Experience working with REST APIs.
* Understanding of platforms like Firebase and Supabase.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
* The candidate must be able to coordinate with backend engineers and have a solid understanding of app architecture.

Interested candidates can share their CV at guddi@goranggo.com

Regards,
